mode.label: Policy Mode

policy.group_evaluation_tip: Rules are matched from the smallest priority number to the largest, and the first matching rule decides the group result. Whitelist mode denies access when no rule matches; blacklist mode allows access when no rule matches. Every effective user and department group must allow access.

policy.province_extra: Match requests from these provinces or states. Chinese and English names are supported. The rule action determines whether access is allowed.
policy.city_extra: Match requests from these cities. Chinese and English names are supported. The rule action determines whether access is allowed.

assets.ssh_gateway_required_after_first_hop: Only SSH gateway can be used after the first hop
assets.custom_header_tip: You can add multiple headers in the format: Key: Value.
assets.import_asset_tip: Reference an existing credential to import its authentication settings. Without a credential, the account and password are used. For key authentication, create a key credential first and reference it in the import file.
assets.import_asset_group_tip: Existing groups are matched by name and missing groups are created automatically; separate nested groups with /, for example: Production/East.
assets.import_asset_error_title: Please check the import file; the following assets failed to import:
assets.credential_delete_referenced_title: This credential is referenced and cannot be deleted
assets.public_validity_tip: After expiry, both direct allow and passcode access stop working.
assets.public_rule_relation_tip: Matching any source IP, location, header, or public path rule allows access without a passcode.
assets.public_geo_rules_tip: Fields use AND; multiple values within a field use OR. Empty fields do not restrict access. Press Enter to add a value.
assets.public_password_access_tip: When no direct access rule matches, visitors can authenticate with the passcode. With no rules and no passcode, anonymous access is allowed. If rules are configured but none match and no passcode is set, NT account authentication is required.
assets.limit_ip_tip: Supports individual IPs, CIDR blocks, and IP ranges; separate multiple values with new lines, commas, or semicolons.
assets.temp_allow_duration_tip: After clicking the button, the current IP is allowed for the duration.
assets.temp_allow_auto_renew_tip: When enabled, each request extends the validity.

certificates.self_signed_tip_title: Tip: You can replace the root certificate yourself; take effect after restart.
certificates.is_default_tooltip: Default certificate is used when no other certificate matches.
certificates.renew_confirm_content: Successfully issued certificates are updated only within the renewal window; earlier requests are skipped. Failed issuance will be retried. Continue?

stats.no_data_desc: Logs will be displayed in realtime during certificate operations

certificates.renew_before_tip: Successfully issued certificates can be renewed within this many days of expiry. A value of 0 uses the default of 30 days. Failed issuance can be retried.
certificates.renew_too_early: The certificate is not yet within its renewal window. Renewal was skipped.

dns_providers.remove_confirm_content: To use this DNS provider for certificate issuance or renewal after removing its settings, configure it again. Existing certificates will not be deleted.

assets.restricted_shell_extra: For restricted SSH environments such as switches, routers, and firewalls. Enabling this option disables SFTP file access, runtime metrics, SSH keepalive checks, and automatic OS detection.
assets.sftp_directory_follow_extra: When enabled, the SFTP file system directory automatically follows the terminal's current directory.
assets.enable_alive_check_extra: Periodically probe the current SSH connection. Some network devices may not support this probe; disable it if connection issues occur.
assets.enable_detect_os_extra: When the asset logo is empty, the system attempts to identify the operating system and apply a matching icon automatically. Some hardware switches may not support this detection; turn it off if connections fail or detection behaves unexpectedly.

ai.enabled_extra: Allow the AI assistant to find and operate this SSH host within the current user’s access permissions.
ai.command_policy_extra: Empty means following the global AI setting.

wol.mac_addr_placeholder: Please enter MAC address, format: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
wol.wakeup_delay_tooltip: Time to wait after sending wake packet

security.mode_extra: Security mode for RDP connection, determines encryption and auth type.
security.ignore_cert_extra: Skip validation of the remote server certificate, including self-signed certificates that cannot be verified.
security.cert_tofu_extra: Trust and save an unknown certificate on first use. Subsequent connections check that the certificate matches the saved record.
security.cert_fingerprints_extra: Enter comma-separated hash algorithm and certificate fingerprint pairs. The server certificate must match one entry; otherwise the connection is rejected.
security.disable_auth_extra: Disable authentication during connection setup. The server still controls login requirements within the remote desktop. Authentication must remain enabled for NLA.

modes.any_desc: Automatically choose based on client and server supported security protocols (default)
modes.nla_desc: Uses TLS encryption and verifies the username and password before the desktop session starts. If credentials are not configured, guacd versions that support interactive authentication can prompt for them.
modes.nla_ext_desc: Same as NLA, but requires server to send additional "early user authorization result"
modes.tls_desc: RDP authentication and encryption via TLS, mainly for load balancer setups
modes.vmconnect_desc: Auto select security mode, limited to Hyper-V/VMConnect supported protocols
modes.rdp_desc: Legacy RDP encryption mode, typically for older Windows servers

website_response_modify.match_method_tip: HTTP method to match (empty matches all methods)
website_response_modify.match_status_tip: HTTP status code to match, e.g., 200, 404 (0 matches all status codes)
website_response_modify.rewrite_headers_tip: Dynamically rewrite original upstream response header values. Later set, add, or remove operations can still modify the result
website_response_modify.rewrite_variable_tip: Replacement values support the website domain variable shown as the default input value. URL host mode preserves the original path, query, and fragment.
website_response_modify.add_headers_tip: Append a response header value, even if the header already exists.
website_response_modify.remove_headers_tip: Response headers to remove (header names only)
website_response_modify.use_regex_tip: Whether to treat search text as a regex

snippet.visibility_tip: Shared snippets are available to all signed-in users. Personal snippets appear only in their creator’s personal list. Administrators can still manage all snippets through resource management.

assets.public_path_whitelist_tip: Click Add, then enter a path; * matches any sequence, ? matches one character, and paths without wildcards match exactly.

Priority mode selects the available member with the lowest priority number; random mode selects an available member at random. Latency mode compares reference values: the latest Agent probe, or 1 ms if unavailable, and a fixed 10 ms for SSH. These values do not measure end-to-end latency to the target asset.

gateways.gateway_delete_referenced_title: Gateway is in use and cannot be deleted
gateways.install_windows_service_tip: After registration, it will be installed as a Windows service and started automatically

session.browser_close_tip: Uses a session cookie. Browsers usually clear it when they close, but restoring a previous browsing session may preserve the login.

password.too_short: Password must be at least {{minLength}} characters long
password.too_simple: Password must include at least {{count}} character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, or special characters
password.character_types_tip: Character types are uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

login_lock.tip: Failed logins are counted separately for each account and IP address. Reaching the threshold applies the corresponding lock duration. Manage locks here:
login_lock.duration_tip: Set to 0 to disable this type of lock.
login_lock.failed_duration_tip: Each failed login restarts the timer. The count expires when the account or IP address has no new failures for this duration.

passkey.origins_tip: Enter an origin with scheme, host, and port if non-default, for example https://nt.example.com:8443. Do not include a path or trailing slash.

asset_access.recording_tip: When enabled, sessions for SSH, RDP, VNC, and TELNET assets are saved for later audit and playback.
asset_access.recording_storage_tip: Settings saved here take precedence over startup configuration. The local recording directory is always read from the configuration file, and WebDAV is only configured here.
asset_access.recording_path_readonly_tip: The local recording directory cannot be changed here. Update the configuration file and restart the service.
asset_access.recording_s3_region_tip: Usually required for AWS S3. It may be left empty for S3-compatible storage when supported by the service.
asset_access.recording_s3_access_key_id_required: Enter the S3 access key ID
asset_access.recording_s3_secret_access_key_required: Enter the S3 secret access key
asset_access.recording_s3_size_invalid: The size must resolve to a whole number of bytes
asset_access.recording_s3_part_size_tip: Size of each upload part, in bytes, KiB, or MiB. The default is 16 MiB.
asset_access.recording_s3_part_size_range: The converted part size must be between 5 MiB and 5 GiB
asset_access.recording_s3_multipart_threshold_tip: Files at or above this size use multipart upload. Choose bytes, KiB, or MiB; the default is 64 MiB.
asset_access.recording_s3_multipart_threshold_range: The multipart upload threshold cannot be less than the part size
asset_access.recording_s3_concurrency_tip: Number of parts uploaded concurrently. The default is 3.
asset_access.recording_s3_concurrency_range: The part concurrency must be an integer from 1 to 100
asset_access.recording_s3_force_payload_signing_tip: Sign the actual payload SHA-256 with fewer signed headers. Use this for S3 services or proxies that do not support UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD or aws-chunked trailers, or that modify request headers.

ai.asset_enable_tip: After enabling global AI, the assistant can search and operate SSH assets that the current user is authorized to access.
ai.disclaimer_description: Content and commands generated by the AI assistant may be incorrect, incomplete, misleading, or dangerous. After enabling it, evaluate outputs yourself and confirm the intent and impact before running any command. Any risks and consequences arising from use of the AI assistant are borne by the user.
ai.disclaimer_required: Please check I understand the risk first
ai.profile_empty: No provider profiles. Create one to get started.
ai.api_type_tip: Select the API type supported by the model provider.
ai.base_url_tip: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint. Trailing slashes are removed automatically.
ai.api_key_edit_tip: Leave this blank while editing to keep the current API Key. Enter a new value to replace it.
ai.models_tip: Enter model names manually, or load the model list from the provider.
ai.models_empty: The model provider did not return any available models
ai.models_load_config_required: Please fill Base URL and API Key first
ai.custom_request_body_tip: Merged into OpenAI request bodies for provider options such as reasoning_effort or thinking.
ai.max_output_tokens_tip: The Anthropic max_tokens value, from 1 to 131072.
ai.reasoning_protocol_tip: Keep the default when the model protocol is unclear; the backend will not attach reasoning fields.
ai.thinking_mode_tip: The thinking-parameter protocol enables thinking by default; reasoning_effort is omitted when thinking is disabled.
ai.thinking_mode_qwen_tip: Qwen omits enable_thinking by default; enabled or disabled is sent as enable_thinking.
ai.reasoning_effort_tip: Only applies to models that support reasoning_effort.
ai.reasoning_effort_thinking_object_tip: The thinking-parameter protocol only supports high or max.
ai.thinking_budget_tip: thinking_budget for Qwen enable_thinking. 0 uses provider defaults.
ai.context_window_tip: Maximum context length of the selected model, used for AI session context control.
ai.max_retries_tip: Maximum automatic retries when model provider requests fail.
ai.user_agent_tip: Leave empty to use the built-in default User-Agent.
ai.http_proxy_tip: Leave blank to connect directly. When configured, this profile uses the proxy for chat and model list requests.
ai.command_policy_tip: This policy controls commands and other host operations initiated by AI. Fewer confirmations improve speed but increase the risk of unintended changes.
ai.command_policy_auto_description: Every AI operation runs immediately without manual confirmation or independent AI review.
ai.command_policy_auto_detail: Fastest and highest risk. Use only in isolated, disposable test environments; not recommended for production hosts.
ai.command_policy_auto_review_description: A separate AI reviews normal operations first; high-risk, unclear, failed, or timed-out reviews require your confirmation.
ai.command_policy_auto_review_detail: Balances automation and safety, but each review adds a model call and latency. Best for controlled environments that need fewer manual prompts.
ai.command_policy_balanced_description: Low-risk read operations run automatically; changes such as writing files, installing software, or modifying services require confirmation.
ai.command_policy_balanced_detail: Recommended for routine host administration. It preserves workflow speed while intercepting operations that may change system state.
ai.command_policy_always_description: Every command or host operation initiated by AI requires your confirmation before it runs.
ai.command_policy_always_detail: Provides the most human control and the most interruptions. Use for production, sensitive hosts, or your first AI-assisted session.
ai.command_timeout_tip: Maximum runtime for one command. When it expires, execution is stopped and the result is returned to AI.
ai.approval_review_settings_tip: Review uses a separate AI request and consumes additional model quota. Cases that cannot be judged reliably still require manual confirmation.
ai.approval_review_profile_tip: Select a provider profile for reviews. Leave blank to use the conversation profile.
ai.approval_review_model_tip: Choose a faster, lower-cost model for reviews. Leave blank to use the review provider profile’s model, or the conversation model if no review profile is selected.
ai.approval_review_timeout_tip: Maximum wait for a review request. A timeout never auto-approves the operation; it falls back to manual confirmation.
ai.recent_output_lines: Terminal Output Lines Sent to AI
ai.include_command_snippets_tip: When enabled, AI can read summaries of command snippets visible to the current user, and request specific content only when needed.
ai.include_host_remark_tip: Allow AI host search results to include remarks that help identify targets.
ai.custom_system_prompt_tip: Appended after the built-in system prompt. Maximum 8000 characters.
ai.clear_history_tip: Only clears your AI conversation history. Other users are unaffected.

display_hints.compact: Collapse execution details, show basic status and display the final answer when complete.
display_hints.standard: Collapse execution details, show the current operation summary and display the final answer when complete.
display_hints.detailed: Show each assistant message, reasoning and tool call.

access_request.enabled_tip: When enabled, users can submit access requests from the resource portal. When disabled, the user entry is hidden and user-side access request APIs are blocked.

http_proxy.readonly_tip: Runtime settings come from config.yaml and are read-only here. Restart the service after changing the file.
http_proxy.template_tip: Templates are returned directly as HTML. Keep required placeholders and ensure the password page contains a form field named password. Changes take effect immediately.
http_proxy.password_page_help: The page must submit a field named password using POST.

geodata.unavailable: No GEO database is available. Region lookup is currently unavailable.
geodata.upload_tip: Click or drag an .mmdb file here, up to 200 MB
geodata.file_too_large: The file must be larger than 0 and no more than 200 MB
geodata.upload_success: The GEO database was uploaded and loaded
geodata.update_available: A new GEO data version is available
geodata.already_latest: The current database is up to date
geodata.update_started: The GEO update task has started
geodata.update_failed: Failed to update the GEO database
geodata.auto_update_time_tip: Runs daily in the server’s time zone.

sshd.tip: When enabled, the system accepts SSH connections at the configured address. Sign in with your system account to access authorized hosts through an SSH client.
sshd.private_key_modal_tip: Generate or paste the SSH server host private key used to identify this server to clients.

port_forwarding.host_port_tip: Separate targets with commas, using host:port. Use * as the port to allow any port. VS Code Remote-SSH requires 127.0.0.1:*.

sshd.usage_tip: The SSH service can open the asset picker or connect directly to a specified asset.
sshd.mode_proxy_tip: Log in with the bastion account first, then choose a target asset from the terminal asset list.
sshd.direct_proxy_tip: Specify the target asset during connection and enter it immediately after authentication. asset-name is the asset name; asset-alias is the recommended asset alias.
sshd.direct_proxy_vscode: Recommended for VS Code Remote-SSH ssh config:
sshd.private_key_required_to_enable: Set a host private key before enabling the SSH service

rdp_proxy.tip: When enabled, users can download .rdp files with short-lived tickets and access authorized RDP assets through a fixed proxy address.
rdp_proxy.public_addr_extra: Address used in generated .rdp files. When empty, it is inferred from the listen address and current request.
rdp_proxy.ticket_ttl_extra: Defaults to 300 seconds. A ticket is consumed as soon as it is validated and cannot be reused.
rdp_proxy.certificate_extra: Leave empty to auto-generate a dedicated self-signed certificate, or select one from the certificate list.
rdp_proxy.usage_tip: Users choose an RDP asset in the web UI to create a ticket. The RDP client connects to the proxy address, and the proxy resolves it to the real asset.
rdp_proxy.ticket_flow_tip: The generated .rdp file embeds the ticket ID and secret in the username: NTICKET:<ticketId>:<secret>. No separate ticket password is needed. Protect the file, as its ticket can be used to connect until it expires.

mail.tip: Tests use the saved, enabled mail service. Save any pending connection changes first. Success means SMTP accepted the request; check the inbox to confirm delivery.
mail.title: Email Subject
mail.site_url_tip: Optional URL for links in personal notifications. If blank, emails ask the recipient to sign in to view details.

notification.work_order_quiet_tip: After a successful delivery, suppress the same event type on the same channel for this duration. SQL request events are exempt.

event_types.system.storage.warning: Local storage usage reached warning threshold
event_types.system.storage.critical: Local storage usage reached critical threshold

notification.recipients_placeholder: Separate multiple recipients with commas, semicolons, or new lines
notification.webhook_url_required: Please enter the full Webhook URL
notification.webhook_url_invalid: Please enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://
notification.wecom_app_origin_required: Please enter the WeCom API URL
notification.wecom_app_corp_id_required: Please enter the WeCom Corp ID
notification.wecom_app_corp_secret_required: Please enter the WeCom App Secret
notification.wecom_app_agent_id_required: Please enter the WeCom App ID
notification.enable_to_configure: This channel is disabled. Enable it to edit its configuration.
notification.specified_users_tip: Reminders do not change approval permissions. Users must enable the corresponding personal channel.
notification.personal_rule_tip: Matching personal rules replace default personal routing for this event. Otherwise results go to the requester and pending reminders to eligible approvers. Quiet periods do not apply.
notification.personal_events_only: Personal notifications only support access request and database work order events
notification.recipient_event_mismatch: Use approvers or specified users for pending events and requester for results. Create separate rules.
notification.binding_tip: Signing in with WeCom from the same corporation and binding the platform account automatically associates the member, without entering a UserId. Administrator bindings take priority; edit and select “Automatic association” to restore automatic matching. Users must also enable WeCom in notification preferences.
notification.binding_reset_tip: Save an empty address to remove the manual binding and restore the login identity from the same corporation.
notification.single_member_required: Enter one member UserId; @all and multiple recipients are not allowed
notification.fixed_recipient_tip: Only used for fixed channel recipients. Personal notifications use member bindings.
notification.supports_personal: Supports personal and fixed recipient notifications.
notification.channel_only: Used for group notifications or webhook events; personal messaging is not supported.

skip_reasons.channel_unavailable: Channel is disabled or mail service unavailable
skip_reasons.binding_unavailable: WeCom member is unbound, disabled or belongs to a different corporation
skip_reasons.preference_disabled: User is disabled or notification preference is off
skip_reasons.record_or_permission_changed: Request was processed, record is missing or approval permission changed

notification.binding_automatic_tip: No member UserId is required. An administrator must enable WeCom login; users then sign in with WeCom and select “Bind existing account”. The login corporation must match the notification channel. Saving automatic association removes any administrator binding. Notification preferences still control delivery.
notification.binding_manual_tip: Fallback: an administrator enters the member account from the WeCom directory. Automatic association usually avoids asking users for a UserId.
notification.approval_auto_tip: Automatic by default: requesters receive approval and execution results; eligible administrators receive pending reminders. Available personal channels are selected automatically, respecting user preferences. No rules are required.
notification.approval_scope_tip: All eligible approvers are notified by default. Select users only to narrow reminders. Approval permissions stay unchanged, results always go to the requester, and channels are automatic.
notification.approval_legacy_tip: Some existing personal notification settings cannot be converted without changing behavior and remain active. Review them in advanced settings. Saving new approval settings replaces the existing settings.
notification.approval_legacy_rules: Existing personal settings still in effect
notification.approval_replace_title: Use the new automatic approval settings?
notification.approval_replace_tip: Saving disables existing personal notification rules and automatically selects channels for the recipients configured here. Approval and execution results go to the requester. Review the recipients before continuing.
notification.rules_extra_tip: Personal approval notifications are automatic and need no rules. Rules here add group messages, fixed email recipients or webhook delivery.
notification.binding_advanced: Advanced: member associations and personal tests
notification.mail_fixed_tip: Personal approval emails automatically use system SMTP and user mailboxes. Configure the mail service once. Fixed recipients below are only for additional rule-based emails.

user_search.filter_tooltip: Used for both synchronization and login eligibility.

ldap.ad_hint: For Active Directory, use sAMAccountName for the username mapping. For LDAPS, use a certificate-matching hostname and trust the CA inside the container.
ldap.mapping_invalid: Invalid saved attribute mapping. Please correct the attribute fields before saving.
ldap.preset_hint: Selecting a directory preset replaces the user filter and attribute mappings. Custom keeps the current settings.
ldap.attribute_invalid: Enter a valid LDAP attribute name.
ldap.url_invalid: Enter a valid ldap:// or ldaps:// server URL without credentials or a search path.
ldap.filter_hint: Used for both synchronization and login eligibility.
ldap.test_success: Connection, service account bind and search succeeded.
ldap.test_has_users: Matching users were found. This test does not verify an individual user password or change settings or users.
ldap.test_no_users: No matching users were found. Check the Base DN and user filter. No settings or users were changed.
ldap.login_hint: LDAP users sign in using Directory account (LDAP). Successful authentication automatically creates new users in the default department; prior user synchronization is not required.
ldap.department_hint: Only applies to newly created users. Existing department memberships and account status are preserved.

oidc.scopes_placeholder: Please enter scopes, separated by spaces, e.g., openid profile email

session.retention_tip: Ended sessions expire based on their connection start time. Cleanup deletes session and command records and removes associated recordings. File operation logs use the same retention period.

login_log.retention_tip: Login logs and administrative operation logs share this retention period.

log.retention_tip: Retention is applied when the log cleanup task runs. Selecting ∞ disables cleanup based on this retention period; manual deletion is still possible.

backup.restore_confirm_content: Restoring overwrites the current PostgreSQL database and restores any CA files included in the backup. A pre-restore backup is created first. Restart the service after restoring.
backup.exclude_tip: Includes the database and CA files, if present. Session recordings and Windows mounted drive files are excluded.
backup.backup_directory_tip: Backup directory: {{directory}}. Backups exclude session recordings and Windows mounted disk files.
backup.upload_restore_confirm_content: Upload a local backup, overwrite the current PostgreSQL database, and restore any included CA files. A pre-restore backup is created first. Restart the service after restoring.
backup.legacy_import_tip: Only used to import JSON data exported from older versions. It is not suitable for full backup restore in the current version.
backup.success_actions_tip: Upload the backup file to remote storage after it is created. Remote upload failures will not delete the local backup file.
backup.saved_secret_placeholder: Saved, leave blank to keep unchanged
backup.webdav_chinese_path_tip: Enter an absolute path that the WebDAV service allows you to access. If the service restricts non-ASCII paths, choose a directory it supports.
backup.task_busy: Another backup or restore task is already running.
backup.task_restore_completed: Restore completed. Restart the service before continuing.
backup.task_safety_failed: Could not create the pre-restore backup. Restore was not started: {{details}}

load_error.title: Failed to load license information
load_error.description: We can't determine which features your current license supports. Check your network connection and try again.

license.name: License Name
license.domain_tip: Used to request a domain-bound license and verify the current access domain. Enter a domain without scheme, port, or path.
license.domain_error: Enter a valid domain without scheme, port, path, or wildcard

restricted.label: Restricted Access
restricted.content: Current license doesn't support this feature.

logo.empty_file: The file is empty. Select an image to upload.
logo.file_too_large: The image must be no larger than 1 MiB.

about.up_to_date: You are using the latest version
about.upgrade_instruction: Run this command in the directory containing docker-compose.yml
about.upgrade_command_copied: Upgrade command copied. Connect to the server to run it
about.upgrade_command_copy_failed: Failed to copy the upgrade command. Please copy it manually
about.version_check_failed: Failed to check for updates. Please try again later

oidc_server.description: Enable the OIDC server so other applications can authenticate users through Next Terminal for single sign-on.
oidc_server.issuer_tooltip: OIDC issuer identifier, usually this system's access address + /api
oidc_server.access_token_ttl_tooltip: Access Token validity, default 3600 seconds (1 hour)
oidc_server.refresh_token_ttl_tooltip: Refresh Token validity, default 604800 seconds (7 days)
oidc_server.id_token_ttl_tooltip: ID Token validity, default 3600 seconds (1 hour)
oidc_server.auth_code_ttl_tooltip: Authorization code validity, default 600 seconds (10 minutes)
oidc_server.manage_tip: After enabling the server, manage connected applications under <link>Identity → OIDC Clients</link>.

network.trust_ip_tip: Enter trusted reverse proxy IP addresses or CIDR ranges to determine whether forwarded client IP headers can be used.
network.direct_ip_tip: Use the IP of the peer connected directly to the server. Behind a reverse proxy, this is usually the proxy’s IP.

sms.webhook_setup_tip: POST custom JSON; any HTTP 2xx response indicates success. Subsequent delivery is not checked.
sms.webhook_headers_tip: Optional JSON object mapping header names to string values, e.g. {"X-API-Key":"your-key"}. Leave blank to retain saved headers; enter {} to clear. Default Content-Type is application/json and can be overridden.
sms.webhook_headers_invalid: Enter a valid header JSON object with string values, unique names, and no HTTP client managed headers such as Host or Content-Length.
sms.webhook_body_tip: String variables: {{phone}}, {{code}}, {{minutes}}, {{language}}. Phone and code are required. Variables are supported in string values only; numbers and booleans retain their types.
sms.webhook_body_invalid: Enter valid JSON containing {{phone}} and {{code}} in string values, using only supported variables.
sms.title: SMS service
sms.tip: Used for account verification and phone changes. Obtain an approved signature and verification template from your provider before saving language templates.
sms.aliyun-pnvs_setup_tip: Enable SMS authentication in Number Verification, use a system-provided signature and matching template, and enter your AccessKey and TemplateCode. Only mainland China mobile numbers are supported.
sms.scheme_name_tip: Optional. Leave blank to use the default scheme. Up to 20 characters.
sms.pnvs_parameters_tip: JSON array supporting code, min, and minutes. System-provided templates typically use ["code","min"]. Match the template variable names; the validity parameter is 5 minutes.
sms.parameters_tip: JSON array supporting code and minutes. Tencent uses positional parameters; Alibaba and Volcengine use named parameters, e.g. ["code","minutes"].
sms.tencent_setup_tip: Obtain a Secret ID, Secret Key, and SMS SDK App ID, then create an approved SMS signature and verification template.
sms.aliyun_setup_tip: Obtain an AccessKey, then create an approved SMS signature and verification template. Use TemplateCode as the template identifier.
sms.volcengine_setup_tip: Obtain an AccessKey and SMS Account, then create an approved SMS signature and verification template.
sms.language_tip: Unconfigured languages fall back to the required Simplified Chinese template.
sms.secret_tip: Leave blank to retain the saved secret. Queries never return the secret.
sms.login_tip: Disabled by default. Allows login with a bound phone number, requires security verification, and enforces phone, IP and global sending limits.

mail_templates.title: Account email templates
mail_templates.tip: Templates follow the user language. Blank fields use built-in templates. Only the following Go template variables are supported. Password reset templates notify administrator resets.
mail_templates.variable_usage: Variables can be used in the subject and body. Use them for the applicable scenario: unavailable text values are empty; Minutes is 0 for emails without a verification code.

variables.SystemName: System name configured in system settings.
variables.NewEmail: Destination of the verification email; the new address being verified for an email change.
variables.Code: Six-digit verification code for email changes and additional email verification.
variables.Minutes: Code validity in minutes; currently 5 minutes.
variables.NewPassword: New password after an administrator reset; available only in administrator password reset notices.
variables.IP: Client IP of the verification or password change request; unavailable in administrator password reset notices.
variables.GenerateTime: Email generation time in UTC using RFC 3339, for example 2026-10-10T08:30:00Z.

verification_services.title: Verification & Messaging Services
verification_services.description: Configure delivery of account verification codes and security emails. Configure event alerts and business notifications through channels and rules in Notifications & Integrations.
verification_services.sms_test: SMS requires provider-approved verification templates. After saving and enabling, a user with a bound phone number can request SMS verification in the account center and confirm receipt.

sms_policy.service_tip: Enable and fully configure the SMS service first.
sms_policy.quota_tip: Login and MFA use separate counters. Quota windows start with the first request. Saving settings preserves usage; failed sends also consume quota.

email_mfa_policy.title: Email MFA
email_mfa_policy.service_tip: Enable and fully configure the mail service first.
email_mfa_policy.quota_tip: Email MFA uses separate counters. Quota windows start with the first request. Saving settings preserves usage; failed sends also consume quota.

sms_test.title: Test SMS
sms_test.success: The provider accepted the request. Please check your phone.
sms_test.tip: Uses saved settings to send test code 123456, which cannot authenticate. Falls back to the Simplified Chinese template when the selected language is unconfigured. Global limit: one per minute and ten per hour, including failed sends.
sms_test.save_first: Save the SMS service settings before sending a test.

service_layout.save_first: Save the service settings before sending a test email.

access_request.start_at: Effective time (blank means immediately after approval)
access_request.scope_tip: Without a matching department configuration, all resources are requestable. A configured empty scope denies requests. Multiple department scopes are combined.
access_request.scope_unconfigured_tip: Users can request any resource when none of their departments has a scope configuration. Otherwise, they can request resources included in any matching department scope.
access_request.scope_delete_confirm: Delete this department scope? Users with no other matching scope will be able to request all resources.
access_request.request_reason_placeholder: Enter the reason for requesting access
access_request.closed_existing_authorization: The user already has valid access permission, so this request was closed.

ai_assistant.title: AI Assistant
ai_assistant.placeholder: Ask a question. Shift + Enter for newline
ai_assistant.command_shortcut_hint: Enter to run, Esc to reject
ai_assistant.pending_placeholder: Press Enter to run or Esc to reject
ai_assistant.context_breakdown_unavailable: Context breakdown will appear after you send a message
ai_assistant.usage_detail: Total input: {{prompt}} tokens; total output: {{completion}} tokens
ai_assistant.remember_approval: Do not ask again for the same command in this conversation (commands only)
ai_assistant.edit_confirm_description: This updates the message, removes all later replies and tool executions, and then generates a new response.
ai_assistant.personal_preferences_tip: Applies only to your account and syncs across devices after saving. Display changes apply immediately; command snippet changes apply to your next request.
ai_assistant.include_command_snippets_tip: Allow AI to view summaries of command snippets you can access and read their content when needed. Turning this off stops providing snippets in future requests; content already in conversation history remains.

asset.mysql_database_extra: Optional. Leave blank to connect without selecting a database, or enter a specific database name.
asset.database_access_extra: This setting does not restrict access to this database. MySQL users can still switch databases with USE. Restrict access through account permissions on the target database server.
asset.postgres_database_extra: Optional. Leave blank to connect to the database with the same name as the user, or enter a specific database name.
asset.postgres_ssl_mode_extra: verify-ca and verify-full use system-trusted CAs. Certificate verification still uses the asset hostname when connected through a gateway.

work_order.reason_placeholder: Please enter reason for executing this SQL
work_order.approve_confirm: Approve this request and execute its SQL?
work_order.unknown_tip: The execution or commit outcome could not be confirmed. Verify the actual result in the target database before executing again.

sql_log.parameter_template_tip: Prepared SQL template; original bound parameter values are not recorded.

proxy.mysql_tls_enabled_tip: Encrypts client connections to the MySQL proxy using the certificate selected below; a dedicated self-signed certificate is generated automatically when none is selected.
proxy.mysql_certificate_extra: Leave empty to auto-generate a dedicated self-signed certificate, or select one from the certificate list.
proxy.pg_policy_tip: SQL filtering reduces accidental operations. Enforce read-only access with database account permissions. Auditing is asynchronous; monitor dropped records and write failures.
proxy.pg_reject_tip: A policy rejection closes the connection and rolls back its active transaction.
proxy.pg_tls_mode_tip: Controls encryption from clients to the proxy. Configure the proxy-to-database SSL mode on the database asset.
proxy.pg_config_error: Failed to load or save configuration. Please retry.
proxy.pg_certificate_error: Failed to load certificates. Check that the certificate exists and retry.
proxy.pg_connection_unavailable: The connection command for the active configuration appears when the proxy is running.
proxy.pg_connection_tls_tip: The require mode encrypts traffic without verifying server identity. Use a trusted certificate and sslmode=verify-full for identity verification; import trust first for self-signed certificates.
proxy.pg_apply_error: Configuration was saved but could not be applied. The current runtime state is shown above.
proxy.block_dml_tip: Prevents accidental changes by blocking writes, locking reads, file exports and unapproved SET statements. Enforce full read-only access with database permissions. Multiple statements and the prepared statement protocol are unsupported.
proxy.mysql_config_error: Failed to load or save configuration. Please retry.
proxy.mysql_certificate_error: Failed to load certificates. Check that the certificate exists and retry.
proxy.mysql_connection_unavailable: The connection command for the active configuration appears when the proxy is running.
proxy.mysql_tls_mode_tip: Controls client-to-MySQL-proxy connections only. Optional mode accepts plaintext; required mode rejects it.
proxy.mysql_connection_tls_tip: REQUIRED enforces encryption only. To verify server identity, use a trusted certificate, --ssl-ca and --ssl-mode=VERIFY_IDENTITY.
proxy.tip: Enable proxy to allow client connections and execute SQL.
proxy.usage_tip: Users connect to the proxy address from a database client, and the proxy forwards traffic to authorized database assets.
proxy.pg_tls_enabled_tip: Encrypts client connections to the PG proxy using the certificate selected below; a dedicated self-signed certificate is generated automatically when none is selected. Plaintext remains available when disabled.
proxy.pg_certificate_extra: Leave empty to auto-generate a dedicated self-signed certificate, or select one from the certificate list.
proxy.public_addr_extra: Address shown in the quick access entry for regular users. When empty, it is inferred from the listen address.
proxy.password_tip: Create a database password in <link>Profile → Access Tokens</link>.

credential_rotation.title: Credential rotation
credential_rotation.description: Centrally update SSH asset passwords and private keys to reduce the maintenance burden of long-lived credentials.
credential_rotation.benefit_1: Rotate credentials in batches or through scheduled policies.
credential_rotation.benefit_2: Update shared credentials across linked assets without editing each asset separately.
credential_rotation.benefit_3: Review rotation results and failure reasons for follow-up.

restricted_features.label: Premium feature
restricted_features.license_note: Your current license does not include this feature.

access_policy.title: Identity access policies
access_policy.description: Define access boundaries by person, source and time for teams with departmental or remote access requirements.
access_policy.benefit_1: Combine IP address sets, location and time conditions.
access_policy.benefit_2: Assign policies to users or departments to reduce repeated setup.
access_policy.benefit_3: Evaluate allow and reject rules by priority for consistent access decisions.

agent_gateway.title: Agent gateways
agent_gateway.description: Deploy an Agent in the target network to provide a shared entry point for asset connections.
agent_gateway.benefit_1: Use Agent connection channels for assets in private networks.
agent_gateway.benefit_2: View gateway online status and versions for routine maintenance.
agent_gateway.benefit_3: Reuse a gateway across assets to simplify cross-network setup.

gateway_group.title: Gateway groups
gateway_group.description: Organize multiple gateways into reusable groups for environments with several connection entry points.
gateway_group.benefit_1: Maintain group members centrally to reduce repeated asset configuration.
gateway_group.benefit_2: Choose gateways by priority, latency or randomly to suit connection needs.
gateway_group.benefit_3: Reuse groups across assets to make future gateway changes easier.

authorization_strategy.title: Operation Policies
authorization_strategy.description: Control file operations and clipboard capabilities according to each team’s responsibilities.
authorization_strategy.benefit_1: Manage file upload and download permissions separately.
authorization_strategy.benefit_2: Set permissions for creating, editing, deleting and renaming files.
authorization_strategy.benefit_3: Control copy and paste capabilities according to operational needs.

command_filter.title: Command filters
command_filter.description: Define terminal command rules for operations that need restrictions on high-risk commands.
command_filter.benefit_2: Apply command rules through resource authorization.
command_filter.benefit_3: Reduce the chance of accidentally executing high-risk commands.

oidc.title: OIDC single sign-on
oidc.description: Connect an existing OIDC identity provider so team members can sign in with their corporate accounts.
oidc.benefit_1: Reuse the corporate sign-in entry point to reduce account maintenance.
oidc.benefit_2: Integrate identity providers through standard OIDC.
oidc.benefit_3: Configure department assignment for users who sign in.

ldap.title: LDAP directory authentication
ldap.description: Authenticate users with information from your existing enterprise LDAP directory.
ldap.benefit_1: Reuse directory accounts to reduce duplicate user maintenance.
ldap.benefit_2: Limit eligible users with search scopes and filters.
ldap.benefit_3: Map user attributes to match your directory structure.

wechat_work.title: WeCom sign-in
wechat_work.description: Let teams sign in through WeCom using their existing corporate identity.
wechat_work.benefit_1: Simplify sign-in with a familiar identity provider.
wechat_work.benefit_2: Configure corporate and application details centrally.
wechat_work.benefit_3: Assign users to departments for platform permission management.

branding.title: Custom branding
branding.description: Give your operations portal a recognizable identity with your organization’s name and logo.
branding.benefit_1: Use a custom system name and logo.
branding.benefit_3: Keep branding consistent across sign-in and administration screens.

session_sharing.title: Session sharing
session_sharing.description: Share a read-only viewing link for the current session to help collaborators review the same situation.
session_sharing.benefit_1: Share the current session instead of describing every step.
session_sharing.benefit_2: View a shared session through its link. Viewers cannot control the remote asset.
session_sharing.benefit_3: Cancel sharing when the task is complete.

website_geo.title: Website location rules
website_geo.description: Allow public access based on the request’s country, region, or city.
website_geo.benefit_1: Configure country, province and city conditions.
website_geo.benefit_2: Use alongside IP and other allow rules. Matching any rule permits public access.

response_rewrite.title: Website response modification
response_rewrite.description: Configure proxy rules to modify a website’s response content or headers.
response_rewrite.benefit_1: Maintain response modification rules in one place.
response_rewrite.benefit_2: Process responses at the proxy to reduce source application changes.
response_rewrite.benefit_3: Apply separate rules for each website.

geodata.title: IP geolocation data
geodata.description: Maintain the IP location data used by regional access rules and source analysis.
geodata.benefit_1: View the state of the geolocation dataset.
geodata.benefit_2: Upload and update data to maintain its version.
geodata.benefit_3: Schedule automatic updates to reduce manual work.

recording_conversion.title: Recording conversion policies
recording_conversion.description: Schedule session recording conversion to balance availability with server processing load.
recording_conversion.benefit_1: Convert after disconnection or during a configured time window.
recording_conversion.benefit_2: Set a time window for conversion work.
recording_conversion.benefit_3: Choose whether to retain original recordings.

access_request.title: Access requests
access_request.description: Route temporary asset access needs through an application and approval process.
access_request.benefit_1: Provide users with a single asset access request entry point.
access_request.benefit_2: Review access requests in the platform to reduce separate coordination.
access_request.benefit_3: Connect requests with resource access management for easier tracking.

sql_work_order.title: SQL Execution Approval
sql_work_order.description: Review and approve database changes before the platform executes SQL.
sql_work_order.benefit_1: Review SQL and the target database before execution.
sql_work_order.benefit_2: Execute approved changes through the platform to reduce manual handoffs.
sql_work_order.benefit_3: Keep requester, approver and execution results together for traceability.

agent_access.enable_api_tip: Allow users to create personal API keys for agents, CLI tools, and automation. Calls remain subject to the user’s permissions and access policies. Disabling pauses existing API keys; enabling restores unexpired, non-revoked keys.
agent_access.disabled_tip: Contact an administrator with permission to modify system settings to enable this feature.
agent_access.key_disabled_tip: API Key access has been disabled. Existing API keys are paused and can still be viewed or revoked. Database passwords are unaffected.
agent_access.title: Agent access
agent_access.description: Install the Next Terminal Skill for OpenClaw, Hermes or custom agents. Install once, then query and manage resources with the installed client.
agent_access.key_instruction: Configure NT_API_KEY securely in the agent environment; do not paste the key into a conversation.
agent_access.setup_tip: Create an API token on the access tokens page and configure NT_API_KEY in the agent’s persistent environment. Install the Skill and client in the next-terminal-api subdirectory of the persistent Skill directory, then load it as required by the framework. Only Python 3 is needed. Use --token-env for a different environment variable name.
agent_access.prompt:
Install the Next Terminal resource management Skill for {{url}}.

1. Identify this agent framework’s persistent Skill directory and use its next-terminal-api subdirectory. Do not use temporary storage or only read the Skill for this conversation.
2. Download {{url}}/agent/next-terminal/install.py and run python3 install.py --base-url {{url}} --directory <persistent-skill-directory>/next-terminal-api. It installs SKILL.md and scripts/nt_api.py and saves instance configuration without secrets. If an existing installation targets another instance, confirm the directory before overwriting it.
3. Load or reload the installed Skill according to the framework. I configured NT_API_KEY in the persistent agent environment. Do not print, save or request the key in chat. If missing, tell me where to configure it.
4. Run the installed scripts/nt_api.py check. Report the installation directory, Skill loading status and account name; report failures accurately.
Also run scripts/nt_api.py permissions to obtain account permissions and the effective license. Check them before selecting interfaces; visibility in the complete document does not authorize calls.
5. Use the installed Skill and client for subsequent authorized resource management tasks.

After installation and verification, wait for my task.
agent_access.permissions: The agent inherits the API key account’s permissions. Set an expiry and revoke the token when retiring the agent.
agent_access.heading: Connect your agent to manage resources
agent_access.step_key_tip: Open access tokens, select the API token type and set an expiry. Copy the new token. If you already have a valid API key, continue to the next step.
agent_access.step_configure_tip: Add NT_API_KEY to the agent secrets, environment or startup configuration. Set its value to your token and reload or restart the agent as required.
agent_access.config_hint: Use NT_API_KEY in configuration that persists across sessions, rather than a temporary terminal. Do not send the key in a conversation.
agent_access.step_agent: Install the Skill and API client
agent_access.step_agent_tip: Send these installation instructions to your agent. It will install the complete Skill and client in its persistent Skill directory, save the instance configuration and verify connectivity.
agent_access.copied: Installation instructions copied. Send them to your agent.
agent_access.copy_failed: Copy failed. Expand the installation instructions and copy them manually.
agent_access.verify_tip: The agent will report the installation directory and connection result. Assign future resource management tasks without repeating setup.
agent_access.advanced_tip: The installed Skill includes interface discovery and API requests. Use these references for custom integrations.
agent_access.disabled_admin_tip: Enable API Key access for Agents, CLI tools, and automation scripts. Existing keys are retained; unexpired, unrevoked keys resume working when access is enabled again.
